perksWithImages.name: Iron Will
perksWithImages.description: While injured and not {Keyword.Exhausted}, your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S04P01.InjuredNoiseReduction%}% quieter.

perksWithImages.name: Help Wanted
perksWithImages.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.

When that Generator is completed by Survivors, your basic-attack cooldowns are {Tunable.K40P01.AttackCooldownReduction%}% shorter for {Tunable.K40P01.Duration}s.

Only 1 Generator can be compromised at a time.

perksWithImages.name: Strength in Shadows
perksWithImages.description:
While in the Basement:
  • You can heal yourself, but {Tunable.S41P02.SelfHealSpeed%}% slower.
  • Whenever you finish healing, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S41P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perksWithImages.name: Unnerving Presence
perksWithImages.description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius get {Tunable.K01P01.SkillcheckOddsIncrease%}% more basic Skill Checks.

The good zone of basic Skill Checks is {Tunable.K01P01.SuccessZoneSizePenalty%}% smaller.
